facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Dubai Marina, within walking distance of Jumeirah Beach, Dubai Marina Mall and the Dubai Tram.
facts.excerpt: InterContinental Dubai Marina is in the heart of the marina, walking distance from the Jumeirah Beach, Dubai Marina Mall, and the Dubai Tram.

facts.text: The Walk and the beach at Jumeirah Beach Residence are a short stroll from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: The Walk and the Beach on Jumeirah Beach Residence have it all and they are just a short stroll from our hotel

facts.text: The hotel puts art at the core of its design.
facts.excerpt: At InterContinental Dubai Marina, we have put art at the core of our design.

facts.text: With design furniture and bespoke art pieces throughout, the lobby doubles as an open-space gallery with statement statues and figurines.
facts.excerpt: With design furniture and bespoke art pieces placed throughout, the lobby area doubles as an open-space gallery with statement statues and figurines.

facts.text: Rooms have high-tech amenities, stylish furnishings and modern artwork.
facts.excerpt: Our luxurious rooms all have high-tech amenities, stylish furnishings, and modern artwork to create a sophisticated contemporary mood.

facts.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: relax and enjoy the views from the glorious floor-to-ceiling windows.

facts.text: Accommodations include Club InterContinental and residences ranging from studios to three-bedroom hotel apartments.
facts.excerpt: Club InterContinental and newly renovated residences from studios to three-bedroom spacious hotel apartments.

facts.text: The penthouse is designed with warm lighting and a soft color palette with hints of green.
facts.excerpt: you are immersed in a chic and refined ambiance, where warm lighting and a soft color palette with hints of green harmoniously blend to create a tranquil oasis.

facts.text: The hotel has a spa and a Pilates studio.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in several social dining venues, Rooftop bar, Pool, Spa, Pilates studio, and modern meeting facilities in the heart of Dubai Marina.

facts.text: The Beauty Spot Spa offers hydrotherapy.
facts.excerpt: Hydro Therapy

facts.text: The outdoor pool at Urban Lounge is heated.
facts.excerpt: Water type: Heated pool

facts.text: The pool includes a whirlpool.
facts.excerpt: Pool includes: Whirlpool

facts.text: At Urban Lounge, guests can sip a drink in a private cabana on the terrace as the pool sparkles against the cityscape.
facts.excerpt: Step out onto the terrace to sip a glass of champagne or a cocktail in your private cabana as the pool sparkles against the spectacular cityscape.

facts.text: Ginter is an intimate gin bar with white walls, retro furniture and marina views.
facts.excerpt: With white walls, retro furniture, soft music and spectacular marina views, it’s the perfect place to meet friends and relax.

facts.text: Accents Restaurant & Terrace serves a Mediterranean-inspired Sunday lunch with live music and views of Dubai Marina.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a relaxed Mediterranean-inspired lunch with generous sharing dishes, live music and beautiful views of Dubai Marina.

facts.text: At Accents, guests can dine outdoors or enjoy the views through a picture window.
facts.excerpt: you can choose to dine outdoors, or sit back and enjoy the fabulous views through a stunning picture window.

facts.text: Kids eat free at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Kids eat free

facts.text: The pool area includes a children's pool.
facts.excerpt: Pool type: Children's Pool

facts.text: Babysitting is available.
facts.excerpt: Babysitting

facts.text: The hotel is single-use plastic free.
facts.excerpt: Single-use plastic free hotel

facts.text: Complimentary valet parking is available for guests.
facts.excerpt: A complimentary valet parking service is also available for guests.

facts.text: Pets are not allowed.

facts.text: The rooms and suites were newly redesigned.
